value.title: dd consume-upgrade: harness on standalone @ai-substrate/dd
value.complexity_breakdown: S=2 I=2 D=1 N=1 F=1 T=2 = 9 (CS-4 large)
value.summary: Replace the in-repo dd implementation with the standalone @ai-substrate/dd SDK, pinned by git sha; a primitive-sufficiency trial decides plan semantics (upstream OQ-2); then drain and delete the fork.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Harness carries a 45-file / 8,173-line fork of dd (services/dd) plus a 12-file verb layer (acts/dd). dd now ships standalone as @ai-substrate/dd, consumed as github:AI-Substrate/dd#<full-sha> (packs on install, proxy untouched, sha is provenance). This plan makes harness its first consumer: phase 1 takes the dependency and rewires every import with a verified public home; phase 2 runs the round-3 primitive-sufficiency trial that decides upstream OQ-2 and re-implements plan semantics on public primitives (or blocks per ratified D-3 while dd exports the gap); phase 3 drains the fork against harness-main history and deletes it, retires the harness dd verbs, and lands the D-2 documentation riders. The builder flow driving this plan runs on the very code being replaced - each phase boundary re-proves the dogfood loop.

sections.name: goals
value: One dd implementation: harness consumes @ai-substrate/dd and the in-repo fork (services/dd + acts/dd) is deleted
Dependency pinned as github:AI-Substrate/dd#<full-40-char-sha>; the 1-week-delayed npm proxy is never on the consume path; re-pin against dd branch shas is the ratified iteration mechanism
Plan semantics preserved: the round-3 primitive-sufficiency trial decides upstream OQ-2 honestly (dated prediction, per-primitive falsifiers), with the existing test estate green throughout
harness dd * verbs retired; standalone dd CLI documented in AGENTS.md (install included) and docs/how; harness doctor warns when it is missing

Dogfood proof AND remediation (Jordan 2026-08-09): defects found in the dd implementation or builder flow while driving this plan are OURS to fix to a working solution - in harness, or in dd via the crab channel + re-pin - never left as silent workarounds
The builder flow and plan validate driving THIS plan keep working on the rewired build at every phase boundary

The OQ-2 verdict (sufficient / insufficient + gaps) is delivered to dd on the crab channel; on insufficiency, phase 2 blocks per ratified D-3 - no local fork, no shim, dd exports and we re-pin

Fork-drain checklist complete before any deletion: every harness-main commit touching services/dd or acts/dd since the dd fork point is enumerated with its sha and confirmed present in dd (merge-base ancestry checked, not assumed)

Dogfood: node harness/cli/bin/harness.js flow orient/rail and harness plan validate run green against plan 080 own documents on the rewired build at each phase boundary

Every dd-implementation or builder-flow defect found while dogfooding this plan is remediated to a working solution (fixed in harness, or fixed in dd and consumed via re-pin) or explicitly ruled by Jordan - the dogfood-findings ledger shows zero silent workarounds; the E450 section-create gap is entry one

value.title: Round-3 trial: plan semantics on public primitives

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Incorporates findings from assets/research-dossier.md (10 findings, 4 historical, 6 risks; every claim re-verified at a named basis: dd @ 7e570bc, harness @ ee8f37fb) and assets/workshops/001-consume-shape-four-decisions.md (Approved: 4 ratified decisions D-1..D-4, verbatim rulings recorded). Two trial rounds and a consumability POC precede this plan.

value.approach: Hybrid (ratified 2026-08-09): TDD for the phase-2 plan-semantics re-implementation - the falsifier case for each primitive is written as a failing test BEFORE the primitive is called sufficient; the existing 423-test flow/plan suite staying green is the bar for the mechanical rewire; lightweight for deletion, docs and verb removal
value.rationale: The rewire is a proven pattern (round 2: tsc exit 0, 423/21 green) - re-testing it deeply re-proves the known; the semantics re-implementation is where wrongness would be silent, so it carries the test-first discipline
value.focus_areas: buildPlanIndex, itemKey, readPlanCheck, readPlanReadiness behaviour parity; the injection seam (foreign fs port through packaged resolver+loader); dogfood loop (flow orient/rail, plan validate) at each phase boundary
value.excluded: Performance testing (no perf-sensitive path changes); Windows-native CI (POSIX suite + the D7-class behavioural probes at the SDK boundary)
value.mock_usage: Fixture-owned fake ports (fs/hash) at the SDK boundary - the repo standard (constitution P3, fakes over mocks); no vi.mock/spyOn; real fs in integration tests

value.location: Hybrid: AGENTS.md (D-2 riders - standalone dd usage + install-when-missing) + docs/how/consuming-dd.md (pin/re-pin discipline, full-sha rule, the POC probe trio); README untouched

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: Three phases, staged so the irreversible half rides on proven ground. Phase 1 repeats the demonstrated round-2 rewire at the current pin for all four surviving consumers (public-home symbols only) and proves the dogfood loop still drives this plan. Phase 2 is the deciding round for upstream OQ-2: prediction dated before the trial, falsifier tests before implementation, and a pre-ratified answer (D-3) if primitives fall short. Phase 3 drains the fork against harness-main history, deletes both dd trees, retires the verbs, lands the D-2 documentation riders, and closes the dogfood-findings ledger Jordan put in scope. Gates G1-G7 run inline; the whole-plan bar is plan validate --complete green plus the full suite on the final tree.

value.finding: 9 plan-semantics symbols (acts/plan/index.ts:30-37, pr-body.ts:1) have no public home; dd src/plan is 6 files / 1091 lines importing 7 non-public internal modules (dossier F-05/F-06, basis 7e570bc)
value.action: Phase 2 trial with the falsifiability discipline; D-3 pre-ratifies the insufficiency answer

value.finding: Dogfood finding #1 (E450): dd set/add cannot CREATE a schema-declared section absent from the document, and plan new seeds 6 of 22 declared sections - the writer verbs cannot author most of builder/plan (harness fork AND dd port share the path: src/acts/write.ts:39 @ 7e570bc)
value.action: Remediation ledger entry 1 per Jordan scope ruling: fix in harness (plan new seeds all declared sections) and/or dd (set/add creates declared-but-absent sections); reported to dd 2026-08-09; this plan was authored via seed-then-validate workaround

value.finding: Fork-drain hazard (dossier H-03): harness-main fixes to services/dd landed after dd forked (e.g. #133 D7); a byte-identical fork diffs clean exactly where upstream deferred a fix
value.action: AC-0006 drain checklist is a deletion-phase precondition with merge-base ancestry proof

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Every dd-side probe names the sha in the COMMAND and the finding (git show <sha>:<path>); never a bare-clone grep - dd main has DIVERGED from the work branch (three-seat trap, 2026-08-09)
Never claim dd lacks an upstream fix without git merge-base --is-ancestor - that claim IS an ancestry assertion
Pin by full 40-char sha; every re-pin re-runs the verify trio (pack shape, injection, A-2 tracked===null)
npm git installs run with the sandbox disabled (git cannot write ~/.npm cache under it; the npm retry masks the cause)
No shim for a missing SDK surface without telling dd first - a workaround is a finding that got absorbed (standing rule, both directions)
harness commands run in-tree only: node harness/cli/bin/harness.js - no global link, no remap (Jordan)
Nothing in services/dd or acts/dd is deleted until the AC-0006 drain checklist is green
Dogfood findings go on the ledger the moment they bite (harness observe + ledger row), and the ledger closes to zero silent workarounds (Jordan scope ruling 2026-08-09)
Phase-1 pin floor: the dep sha must be f712ded or later (type SchemaFs importable); annotate ports at declaration (const fs: SchemaFs = ...) so compile errors land at the write site

Materiality threshold for remediation growth is DEFINED and falsifiable in assets/dogfood-ledger.md (4 conditions: outside touch set / >150 lines or new public surface / >3 fixes per phase / needs dd-side ratification) - defined 2026-08-09 before any contest
